issue.title: bob gmail draft plain Reply ignores the Reply-To header
issue.description:
A plain `## Reply` drafted with `bob gmail draft` addresses the selected message's `From` header and never reads its `Reply-To` header. gog (and Gmail) reply to `Reply-To` when present (`buildReplyRecipients` in gogcli `internal/cmd/gmail_recipients.go`: `replyTarget := parseMailboxHeader(info.ReplyToAddr)`, falling back to `From`).

Root cause: `compose_request` in `src/native/gmail/compose/draft.rs` builds plain-reply recipients from `target_message.first_header(HeaderKind::From)` and passes them to gog as an explicit `--to`, which overrides gog's own Reply-To handling. `grep -rn -i 'reply-to' src/native/gmail` finds no Reply-To reader.

Found while fixing self-sent reply recipients (same function; `reply_recipients` now answers a message you sent with its To recipients). The fix should honor `Reply-To` first (excluding the account's own address), keep the self-sent fallback, add a fake-gog test with a Reply-To header in `tests/gmail_draft.rs`, and update the reply sentence in docs/gmail.md "Gmail drafts".

task_type_fields.impact: Plain Replies to messages with a Reply-To header reach the wrong mailbox (or a no-reply From address); Reply all is unaffected because gog resolves it.
task_type_fields.repro: Save a thread whose last message carries `Reply-To: list@example.com` and `From: person@example.com`, run `bob gmail reply NOTE`, add text, then `bob gmail draft NOTE -f json`: the preview's `to` is the From address, while replying in Gmail (or `gog gmail drafts create --reply-to-message-id ID` without `--to`) addresses the Reply-To address.

issue.creation_reason: Found while fixing Bob's self-sent reply recipients: a Reply to mailing-list, ticketing, or ATS mail that sets Reply-To goes to the From address instead of where the sender asked replies to go.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction 2026-11-11 while drafting recruiter replies: LinkedIn InMail notifications are From inmail-hit-reply@linkedin.com with a per-conversation Reply-To. bob gmail reply / draft would address From (compose_request / reply_recipients), so Jack C.'s ConsultNet InMail was filed as LinkedIn message text instead of a Gmail draft. Plan: plan:202611/recruiter_email_reply_drafts.md.
